LESSON: GROWING TREES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: AGRICULTURE
Strand: Conservation of Resources
Topic 1.4: Growing Trees

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Growing Trees
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How can growing trees conserve the environment?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment
2. plant trees to conserve the environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Growing Trees

Teach
• Observe Growing Trees in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Growing Trees (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Growing Trees.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Growing Trees.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Growing Trees.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment
• plant trees to conserve the environment

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Growing Trees.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Growing Trees: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How can growing trees conserve the environment?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• explain the importance of trees in conserving the environment
• plant trees to conserve the environment

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
